chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim, from 'Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ribat, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام:
Concerning a man who has sores on his body and then janabah affects him, he عليه السلام said: "He performs tayammum."

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةُ: the state of major ritual impurity requiring ghusl
key_terms.الْقُرُوحُ: sores or wounds on the body
key_terms.يَتَيَمَّمُ: he performs tayammum as a substitute for water purification

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a person with sores on his body becomes junub?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a person whose body has sores and who enters the state of janabah. In such a case, he should perform tayammum instead of using water, indicating accommodation in ritual purity law when water use is harmful.
